video_goal: Demonstrate how to properly set up and use a TheraGun Prime to massage the trapezius muscle.
single_prompt: A close-up shot shows a black TheraGun Prime massage device with a distinctive triangular handle and a round foam Dampener attachment, held by a person wearing a grey athletic shirt, resting on a table. The person pushes the stem of the Dampener attachment firmly into the front nozzle of the TheraGun Prime until it sits flush. The camera moves to an extreme close-up as the person presses and holds the center power button on the keypad until the white LED speed indicators illuminate and the device vibrates. They press the down arrow button to drop the vibration speed to the lowest LED indicator. The camera pulls back to a medium shot as the person wraps a hand around the top section of the triangular handle using an overhand grip. Transitioning to an over-the-shoulder view, they lift the vibrating device and hover the Dampener attachment just above the right trapezius muscle at the base of the neck. In a close-up, they gently lower the flat surface of the Dampener attachment so it makes contact with the skin. They slowly glide the vibrating head outward along the ridge of the right trapezius muscle toward the shoulder joint, then slowly glide it back inward along the same path. Holding the Dampener attachment completely still on the midpoint of the right trapezius, they allow the vibration to pulse in one spot without applying extra pressure. The camera shifts to a medium shot as they lower the device, switch hands on the triangular handle, and lift it toward the left side of the neck. From an over-the-shoulder view, they glide the Dampener attachment slowly outward along the left trapezius muscle from the neck base to the left shoulder. Finally, in a close-up, they pull the device away from the body and press the center power button to turn off the LED lights and stop the motor, all set in a brightly lit modern living room with soft natural sunlight filtering through sheer white curtains.
